fields.topology_type: Master/slave shared bus per channel. One NAND Flash Controller (master, host) drives CLE/ALE/WE_n (or CLK), RE_n (or W/R_n), DQ[7:0], DQS (NV-DDR family), CE_n[N-1:0]. One or more NAND Targets (slaves) per channel share the strobes and DQ; the host selects a single target at a time via its CE_n pin (or via Volume Select after CE_n pin reduction). R/B_n is open-drain device-driven and wired-OR across targets.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + single target (per channel)
supported_topologies.description: One NAND package per channel; simplest. Used in low-end embedded SSDs and consumer USB drives.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-target with per-target CE_n
supported_topologies.description: Up to 4 (or more on BGA-272 / BGA-316) targets per package; host selects one at a time via CE_n. Standard multi-die SSD package.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-target with CE_n pin reduction (Volume Select)
supported_topologies.description: Shared CE_n; per-target Volume Address enumerated via ENi/ENo daisy chain; Volume Select (E1h) directs subsequent commands.

supported_topologies.name: Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16)
supported_topologies.description: Two parallel DQ buses (DQ_0 [IO0_0..IO7_0] + DQ_1 [IO0_1..IO7_1]) on a single package for double per-package throughput. Each bus has its own DQS and ODT.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-channel host controller
supported_topologies.description: SSD controller drives multiple independent ONFI channels (typ. 4 / 8 / 16); each channel runs ONFI independently for parallel throughput.

supported_topologies.name: Matrix termination (ODT)
supported_topologies.description: NV-DDR3 multi-target channel: per-LUN ODT state (Deselected / Selected / Sniff) configured via ODT Configure (E2h) to balance signal integrity at high data rates.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates all command/address strobes (CLE+WE_n, ALE+WE_n) and clock (CLK on NV-DDR). Drives CE_n per target. Issues all commands. Runs ZQ + DCC + DQ training loops. Owns ECC (raw NAND) or offloads to in-package controller (EZ NAND). Implements FTL.
Decodes command/address from DQ; drives data on RE_n falling edge (SDR) or DQS edges (NV-DDR family). Pulls R/B_n LOW during operations. Stores Parameter Page + Unique ID + factory bad-block map.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer router or bridge — the bus is a flat 1-host : N-target bus per channel. Multi-target arbitration is purely time-domain: only one target may drive DQ / DQS / R/B_n (open-drain) at a time, selected by its CE_n (or Volume Address after CE_n reduction).

ordering_guarantees.within_a_page: Bytes streamed in column order from the page register. Read Cache Sequential maintains row-major order. Multi-plane operations: all plane outputs concurrent on the same DQ bus (turn-around via Read Status Enhanced + Change Read Column Enhanced).
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Strictly serial within a single LUN — each command must complete (RDY=1) before the next is issued. Across LUNs: parallel execution allowed; host must poll per-LUN via Read Status Enhanced.
ordering_guarantees.multi_plane: Multi-plane Page Program / Erase / Read execute concurrently within a LUN; final FAIL bit is per-plane (read via Read Status Enhanced with plane address).
ordering_guarantees.page_cache: Page Cache Program allows next-page submission while prior-page array program in progress; FAILC reports prior result.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: The device exposes a hierarchical block→page→column address space. Address cycles: column (LSB-first) selects byte offset within a page; row (LSB-first) selects (LUN, plane, block, page). No memory-mapped peripheral region is exposed on the bus — Parameter Page / Unique ID / Status are accessed via dedicated commands (ECh / EDh / 70h) rather than memory-mapped reads.

device_classification.raw_nand: Pure NAND die with no in-package controller; host runs full ECC + FTL.
device_classification.ez_nand: NAND + in-package controller (ECC, optionally lithography-specific management); reduced host-side burden.
device_classification.multi_lun_target: Single CE_n drives multiple LUNs (dies) sharing one package; host polls per-LUN status.
